summary: Restoration pledges target at least 1,500 ha of mangroves and more than 3,000 ha of riparian forest by 2025; mangroves alone equal about 13.3% of current mapped wetland. Conservation goals include 32% forest cover, forest-fire degradation reduced to 36,972 ha annually, technical studies for two and incorporation of one new Pacific coastal protected area by 2025, and watershed management, protection planning and water-quality indices in 35%, 50% and 10% of watersheds. SIGAP coverage is reported as 32–33%. Mixed actions seek 30,300 ha of additional forest restoration/management by 2025, including a 10,659-ha agroforestry sub-target, plus sustainable livestock on at least 13,500 ha. The first two equal about 0.42% and 0.15% of current forest; livestock and separate goals of 19,500 additional ha under soil conservation and at least 40,000 ha of pasture improvement equal 0.47%, 0.67% and 1.38% of current agriculture. Carbon measures quantify 129,330–1,545,200 t CO2-eq in reductions or sequestration.
